Identify a valid rectangle using row-wise histograms

bkamp_rectangle.Rd

Find a count-valid rectangle with the smallest point count using the points in the available cells.

Usage

bkamp_rectangle(
  grid_mat,
  max_aspect_ratio,
  ppp_obj,
  n_min,
  x_coords,
  y_coords,
  ref_wd,
  ref_hi,
  univariate = TRUE
)

Arguments

grid_mat

Binary availability matrix; rows run from top to bottom.

max_aspect_ratio

Maximum longer/shorter side ratio of a candidate.

ppp_obj

A point pattern object of class "ppp" from the spatstat package.

n_min

Target/background minimum counts, or type1/type2/background counts.

x_coords, y_coords

Increasing grid boundary coordinates.

ref_wd, ref_hi

Width and height of a grid cell.

univariate

A logical value indicating whether to compute univariate KAMP (default is TRUE).

Value

The selected rectangle bounds, or NULL if no candidate is valid.
